fieldValues.title: Relation
fieldValues.description: A first-class, typed, independently identified assertion between two instances. It is always binary, a source and a target and never a set, and it always reads in one direction: source, relation type, target. Only the forward form is stored; the inverse is derived for display and never written. A Relation is a semantic claim carrying its own provenance, not a container, not ownership, and not a lifecycle act: asserting one never changes a state.
fieldValues.notes: Relations are reserved for assertions with semantic consequence. A lightweight prose mention or citation must not be modelled as one (Invariant 17). Relations span tiers, so a Note may be the target of edges from the Records it became.
